name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah. Are you alone today, Big Brother?」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like everyone has various things to take care of」

name: Macaron
message: 「For an unpopular big brother like you, I'll tag along partway」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can't do it unless it's somewhere wide open, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Training is just a given, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Can I tag along too?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Are you gonna do something too, Big Brother?」

name: Macaron
message: 「What are you planning to do by observing me?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't just pop out of nowhere and say something so obscene」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll chop you into mincemeat right here\s04」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I did that, Alzard would get all dirty」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Because you keep staring at me, Big Brother, it's hard to focus!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll close my eyes and just listen to your voice」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, haven't you gotten tired of watching by now?」

name: Synn
message: 「When it comes to you, Macaron, I feel like I could watch forever and never get tired of it」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn is just that fascinated by you, shorty」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Paqy! Don't phrase it like that, it's embarrassing!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're the one who should be embarrassed, Onii-chan! You really are a pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「Jeez, you made her mad because of what you said, Paqy」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I was the one watching Macaron, though……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aww, somehow I totally lost my motivation」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, let's take a little break then--here, some milk」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, you're as amazing as ever, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「……Besides, even if you force yourself to praise me, it doesn't make me happy」

name: Macaron
message: 「I just got a little nervous, that's all」
She turns away with a huff.
Even every single one of those casual gestures never seems to get old to watch, for some reason.

name: Synn
message: 「When I watch you working hard like this, Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「It makes my chest feel kinda warm, or makes me feel like I gotta work hard too……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez…… saying embarrassing stuff like that again……」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm gonna train together with you too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, are you an idiot or what!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Seriously, you're weird, big brother. Why would you…… 」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I feel like I finally understand」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother, you were gonna say something embarrassing again!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're just enjoying making me embarrassed. I'm sure of it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have such bad taste. It's not like I'm Paqy」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're a pretty weird guy, big brother」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it really that weird that I like you, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I didn't hear anything just now, okay!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Th-That, l-l-l-like, saying you love me to win me over--it's not gonna work!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I hate you so much, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「So-so, huh. Well, it's better than being hated」

name: Synn
message: 「Come here, I'll wipe it for you」

name: Synn
message: 「You'll look uncool if you leave it like that」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-I just got defiled out of nowhere...」

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't stand out much, so it's fine」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, and here I was sleeping so peacefully」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, you can go ahead and head back」

name: Synn
message: 「While doing squats, it gradually started getting fun」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is Big Brother planning to stay even longer……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Saying weird things like that makes it hard to keep going……」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come to think of it, Big Brother…… is actually pretty well-built, isn't he……」

name: Macaron
message: 「When he's focused on something like that, he might actually look cool……」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, none of that really matters right now...」

name: Synn
message: 「How about it, Macaron? Ready to call it a day soon?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Auu... Even I might be getting tired...」

name: Macaron
message: 「My arms feel like they're gonna cramp...」

name: Macaron
message: 「B-But if you're gonna keep going, Big Brother, I won't lose!」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, your arms are shaking a bit. Are you okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm just trembling with excitement! Totally fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I think I'll wrap things up here for today.」
The instant she does, she drops Alzard and collapses limply to the ground.
She throws a tantrum at him.

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about we head back now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't be helped, then. Here, I'll give you a piggyback ride.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're gonna give me a piggyback ride...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey, Lord Synn! What am I supposed to do with this catch?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Guess I got no choice--wait, hey, don't be ridiculous!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I love it up here! It's the best!」
Hearing Macaron say she likes it really makes me this happy, huh.
A grin spreads across my face before I can stop it.

name: Synn
message: 「I couldn't even blame anyone for calling me a pervert~」
Well, as long as we're getting along, I guess it's fine.
